promptVersions.body:
The following Mogli-related fields may be added to Contacts, Leads, or any other custom Objects:


  • Mogli Number essential for sending/receiving texts - the reformatted Mobile number that is auto-populated by a workflow from the value in the Mobile field. It acts as a unique identifier for each Contact or Lead. The workflow removes spaces, parentheses, and dashes from the Mobile field, reformatting it like this: +12223334444
  • Mogli Avatar URL optional - you may enter an image's URL to be associated with this record within Conversation View. If left blank, the Contact or Lead’s initials will display in its place.
  • Default Gateway optional - the most commonly-used outbound phone number the Contact or Lead is used to receiving texts from. Populating this field helps keep consistency for your recipient. In the event that multiple users reach out to this recipient, populating this field will allow the user to send texts from a number the recipient recognizes.
  • Mogli Opt Out optional - the checkbox on a Contact or Lead record that identifies whether they've provided opt-in consent. When checked, Conversation View is disabled for the Contact or Lead and users will no longer be able to send them a message.


To start texting:


  1. Click Edit (on the upper right corner of the record)
  2. Enter a value in the Mobile field (can be in any format)
  3. Save the record
  4. Notice your reformatted Mobile number in the Mogli Number field
  5. In the conversation view component, type a message into the text box
  6. Click Enter or click the red arrow
  7. Watch your text arrive right away
  8. Respond to your text message and keep an eye on the conversation view


You now know the basics of 1:1 conversations with Mogli SMS!


But, what about all the other options in the conversation view?


  • Click the gear icon to filter your conversation based on user. This helps you differentiate who has contributed to the conversation. Here, you'll also be able to customize your text and bubble colors.
  • Beneath the text field, the first drop-down menu on the left is the outbound phone number (Gateway). This is where you'll select the number you want to send the message from. If you select the -Default- value, your message will be sent from the Default Gateway populated on the record. If there isn't one, it'll be sent from the global Default Gateway. Otherwise, select any number available.
  • To the right is the SMS Template drop-down. This is where you'll find pre-created messages and survey-starters or automated conversations.
  • Below those two fields, you'll have the option of scheduling a message. Simply type in your message, select your date and time, and click the red arrow. You'll notice a little clock icon beneath your message to indicate that it's scheduled.
promptVersions.description: About the Mogli Number, Default Gateway, Mogli Avatar URL, and Mogli Opt Out fields. And how to Edit > Enter Mobile Number > Save > Watch Mogli Number
promptVersions.title: Fields and Step-By-Step Instructions
